response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, experienced full-stack and backend developer with strong systems-level background (Dlang, low-latency services, GIS platform work), but his profile is a mismatch for a C++/Rust-focused routing tiling role. His recent and most substantial professional experience is in TypeScript/Node.js product engineering, with C++ limited to a brief stint nearly a decade ago and no listed Rust experience at all. While his GISCollective project shows genuine geospatial domain interest, it does not involve the required systems-level C++/Rust routing pipeline work.
strengths: Genuine geospatial/GIS domain experience via GISCollective open-source platform
Strong distributed systems and low-latency background from Dunnhumby (async I/O, fibers, high-throughput microservices)
Demonstrated adaptability across many languages and technology stacks over a long career
concerns: No current or recent C++ experience (last used ~2014-2015) and no evidence of Rust experience
Core recent expertise is TypeScript/Node.js product engineering, not systems programming
No direct experience with routing/navigation guidance pipelines or map tile generation at scale
